get.description: Fetch a secret's metadata. The raw value is never returned.

patch.description: Update a secret's metadata (label, description, provider hint, scopes). Use POST /rotate to change the value.

delete.description: Permanently delete a secret. References to it from existing pipe configs will hard-fail at runtime.

post.description: Replace a secret's encrypted value in place. Mask is regenerated; rotated_at/by are recorded.
